description: This file contains unit tests for Azure Queue streaming client functionality in the Orleans framework. It includes test setup, configuration, and specific test methods for producer and consumer behavior when clients are dropped.

classes.name: AQClientStreamTests
classes.description: Test class for Azure Queue streaming client functionality, setting up the test environment and defining test cases for dropped client scenarios.

classes.name: MyClientBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the client builder to include Azure Queue stream provider and sets client drop timeout.

classes.name: MySiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the silo builder to include Azure Queue stream provider and in-memory storage.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the test cluster asynchronously and sets up the test runner.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster with Azure Queue streams and memory storage.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of resources, cleaning up Azure queues and storage after tests.

methods.name: AQStreamProducerOnDroppedClientTest
methods.description: Test method for producer behavior when the client is dropped.

methods.name: AQStreamConsumerOnDroppedClientTest
methods.description: Test method for consumer behavior when the client is dropped.
